gloss: so much, this much, like this

definitions.gloss: so much, this much, to this extent
definitions.explanation: Used to indicate the degree or extent of something near the speaker.

examples.japanese: こんなに{暑|あつ}いとは{思|おも}わなかった。
examples.english: I didn't think it would be this hot.

examples.japanese: こんなに{多|おお}くの{人|ひと}が{来|き}るとは。
examples.english: I didn't expect so many people to come.

examples.japanese: こんなに{早|はや}く{終|お}わった。
{日本語|にほんご}がこんなに{難|むずか}しいとは{知|し}らなかったので、{最初|さいしょ}は{苦労|くろう}した。
examples.english: I didn't know Japanese was this difficult, so I struggled at first.

notes:
こんなに indicates degree relative to the speaker.

RELATED SERIES:
- こんなに: this much (near speaker)
- そんなに: that much (near listener)
- あんなに: that much (far from both)
- どんなに: how much (question)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- こんなに〜とは{思|おも}わなかった (didn't think it would be this ~)
- こんなに〜なんて (to be this ~ !)
